notes: How high the crew lifts (Truck setup in the load panel, or the truck editor): the highest a case gets lifted onto a stack in that truck, floor to the bottom of the case. Pack the rest, + and Choose a truck don't stack a case higher, and a case put there by hand says so. Blank (the default) is no limit. Pick cases from the keyboard: [ and ] select the previous and next case in loading order, so turn, tip, nudge, hide and take out all work without the mouse.
